upcoming.title: Let Her Sing® 2026: A Celebration of Female Voices | SAN DIEGO
upcoming.excerpt: For the first time in San Diego, Diaspora Arts Connection, in collaboration with the Persian Cultural Center of San Diego, presents Let Her Sing®: A Celebration of Female Voices on Saturday, October 24, 2026.

location.addressTitle: California Center for the Arts, Escondido

upcoming.title: Let Her Sing® 2026: A Celebration of Female Voices | Film Screenings
upcoming.excerpt: As part of the 10th anniversary of Let Her Sing®: A Celebration of Female Voices, Diaspora Arts Connection & Farcinema present a special program of films at YBCA on Sunday, October 11, 2026, exploring the lives of women who refuse to let censorship, social expectations, and restrictions on artistic expression silence their voices.
